scenarios.title: Non-standard layouts, shared footnotes and tables
scenarios.action: Open both articles, follow the two [a] markers, inspect the table and compare the versions.
scenarios.expected: Mixed roots, skipped levels, interleaved text, literal labels and structural moves survive publication.

scenarios.expected: Old snapshots retain their text; corrections share one legal identity.
